content.title: Collector Files Complaint Against Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam MLA
content.caption: The Collector of Kallakurichi has filed a formal complaint against Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam MLA C. Arul Vignesh.

slides.heading: Collector Files Complaint Against Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam MLA
slides.text: The Collector of Kallakurichi has filed a formal complaint against Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam MLA C. Arul Vignesh.

slides.heading: Complaint Details
slides.text: The complaint alleges inappropriate advances and unwarranted messages.
